biggest_catch: The payout is 30,000 Membership Rewards points worth only $240 in cash at Amex's own standard Redeem-for-Deposits rate (1,000 pts = $8) — and it takes 8–12 weeks after you finish all requirements to receive them.
catches: Welcome Bonus: 30,000 Membership Rewards points. At the provider's own standard Redeem-for-Deposits rate (1,000 points = $8), this equals $240 cash deposited into the checking account.

To earn it: (1) open your first Amex Business Checking account (subject to approval); (2) deposit $5,000+ in eligible deposits that post within 30 days of account opening; (3) maintain a $5,000+ average daily balance for 60 days starting when deposits reach $5,000; (4) complete 5 qualifying transactions within 60 days of account opening.

Qualifying transactions: mobile deposits, check deposits by mail, ACH, wire, and bill payments. Excluded: debit card transactions, Zelle payments, Redeem-for-Deposits points deposits, transfers between Amex accounts, stop payments, unposted transactions.
Eligible deposits exclude deposits from other Amex deposit accounts, interest payments, points-redemption deposits, and Zelle payments.
Not eligible if the business currently has or has had an Amex Business Checking account (first-account bonus only).

Points are credited to the linked Membership Rewards account within 8–12 weeks of completing all criteria; the checking account must be open at fulfillment. Amex may withhold points or close accounts for abuse/misuse/gaming.
The Welcome Bonus may be taxable income and may be reported on IRS Form 1099; you are responsible for federal/state taxes.
Amex reserves the right to modify or revoke the bonus at any time without notice. Account offered by American Express National Bank, Member FDIC.
No monthly maintenance fee and no account-opening fee, so the main cost is parking $5,000 for 60+ days. 1.00% APY on balances up to $500,000 (as of 9/15/2026).

payout_quote: To earn a Welcome Bonus of 30,000 Membership Rewards points, you must meet each of the following qualifying criteria: 1. Open your first American Express Business Checking account, which is subject to approval; 2. Deposit a total of $5,000 or more in eligible deposits that you make and are posted to your account within thirty (30) days of account opening; 3. Maintain an average daily balance in your account of at least $5,000 for sixty (60) days, starting on the date that your eligible deposits are equal to $5,000 or greater; and 4. Complete five (5) qualifying transactions within sixty (60) days of account opening. | After you have completed all the above qualifying criteria, American Express will credit the Membership Rewards points to the Membership Rewards Program Account linked to your American Express Business Checking account within 8-12 weeks, provided that your Business Checking Account is opened at the time of fulfillment. | The Welcome Bonus may be taxable income to you and may be reported on IRS Form 1099. | You may redeem Membership Rewards points for deposits into your American Express Business Checking Account at the standard rate of 1000 points for an $8 deposit.

steps: Open your first American Express Business Checking account (subject to approval) — the business must not currently have or have had one.
Within 30 days of account opening, make $5,000 or more in eligible deposits that post to the account (exclude transfers from other Amex accounts, interest, points-redemption deposits, and Zelle).
Maintain an average daily balance of at least $5,000 for 60 days, starting on the date your eligible deposits reach $5,000.
Complete 5 qualifying transactions within 60 days of account opening (mobile deposits, check deposits by mail, ACH, wire, or bill payments — not debit card, Zelle, or Amex-account transfers).
The 30,000 points are credited within 8–12 weeks of completing all criteria (account must be open); redeem them for deposits at 1,000 points = $8 ($240).
